استقطبن (form X)
# اِسْتَقْطَبْنَ (istaqṭabna) /is.taq.tˤab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
# اُسْتُقْطِبْنَ (ustuqṭibna) /us.tuq.tˤib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
# اِسْتَقْطِبْنَ (istaqṭibna) /is.taq.tˤib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
